record.summary: Sheela Narayan lent Rs.2,00,000 to her cousin Mohan Das about eight years ago to help him start a small shop. Mohan promised to repay within two years but never made any payment. Over the years Mohan gave vague acknowledgments of the debt at a family gathering (about five years ago), via a WhatsApp message (about three years ago) and a voice note (about two years ago). Recently Sheela asked again for repayment and Mohan denied owing anything. She wants to file a case to recover the loan amount plus interest.
record.goal: Recover the loan amount of Rs.2,00,000 and applicable interest from Mohan Das.
questions: What is the exact date (day, month, year) of the bank transfer loan?

Do you have any documents or messages that mention the specific amount of Rs.2,00,000 in the later acknowledgments (WhatsApp or voice note)?
In which city or state do you and Mohan reside, and where was the loan transaction made?
evidence: Bank statement showing transfer of Rs.2,00,000 to Mohan eight years and two months ago with the narration "loan to Mohan".
WhatsApp message from Mohan dated about three years ago stating "give me some time, I haven't forgotten."
Voice note from about two years ago in which Mohan says "I know I owe the family, will sort it out."
